Please note action indicated by check mark below or on reverse side.
The Summary Notification of Intent to apply for Federal aid for the above project was received by the State Clearinghouse on 4/3/72. The project has been assigned a State Clearinghouse Control Number, which along with the applicant's name and the project title, should be used in all future correspondence on this project. Notification of completion of the initial review by the State Clearinghouse may be expected by 5/12/72.
A copy of the Summary Notification for the above project is enclosed for your review and comment, in accordance with the OMB Circular A-95 intergovernmental review requirements. Your review should focus especially on the intended application's compatibility with the plans, programs and objectives of your agency.
